Class AzureFileManager

Namespace
NuvTools.Storage.Azure
Assembly
NuvTools.Storage.Azure.dll

Provides file management operations for Azure Blob Storage. Implements IFileManager using Azure Blob Storage as the underlying storage provider.

public class AzureFileManager : IFileManager
